name: hierarchical-teams
title: A research team and a writing team, with managers

comparison.purpose: Two teams under one coordinator, each team its own child machine with typed input and output. The research manager picks SEARCH, SCRAPE or FINISH each turn, but after a two-step worker budget the guards leave only FINISH; the writing team drafts from what came back, and the coordinator may send it back for research once before PUBLISH is the only way out.
